name: [CLONING👥] PAINT OR DIE!
desc:
Paint your Dummy, Camouflage into the map, and hide from the Seekers!

🖌️ PAINT YOURSELF: Navigate all color pools and coat your avatar!
🦎 BLEND: Blend into walls, floors, and objects!
🏆 SURVIVE: Fool the seeker with clever hiding spots!

Will you blend into the map... or DIE trying? ☠️👀

✨ Like and Favorite the game if you enjoyed playing!
Inspired by Meccha Chameleon
